<infobox theme="astro">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
	<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Astrographical information</header>
        <data source="region"><label>Region</label></data>
        <data source="sector"><label>Sector</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{sector|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{sector|}}}}}|n/a||{{{sector|}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="coordinates"><label>Grid square</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates|}}}}}|canon-only||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates}}}}}|n/a||{{{coordinates|}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="xyz"><label>XYZ coordinates</label></data>
        <data source="quadrants"><label>Quadrants/regions</label></data>
        <data source="suns"><label>Suns</label></data>	
        <data source="orbits"><label>Orbiting bodies</label></data>
        <data source="stations"><label>Space stations</label></data>
        <data source="asteroids"><label>Asteroids</label></data>	
        <data source="comets"><label>Comets</label></data>	
        <data source="nebulae"><label>Nebulae</label></data>		
        <data source="routes"><label>Trade routes</label></data>
        <data source="other"><label>Other objects</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Societal information</header>
        <data source="species"><label>Native species</label></data>	
        <data source="otherspecies"><label>Other species</label></data>	
        <data source="socialgroup"><label>Socio-cultural group(s)</label></data>
        <data source="language"><label>Language</label></data>
        <data source="population"><label>Population</label></data>	
        <data source="imports"><label>Major imports</label></data>	
        <data source="exports"><label>Major exports</label></data>        
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>	
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:System|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|name|region|sector|coordinates|xyz|suns|orbits|stations|asteroids|comets|nebulae|other|routes|quadrants|species|otherspecies|socialgroup|language|population|imports|exports|affiliation|optional=unlisted,no_grid_check|ignore=name,no_grid_check}}<!--
-->{{#if:{{NAMESPACE}}{{{no_grid_check|}}}||{{#invoke:PlanetGridCheck|main|outside=1|region={{{region|}}}|sector={{{sector|}}}|system=N/A|unlisted={{{unlisted|}}}}}}}<noinclude>[[category:Astrographical infobox templates]]

==Usage instructions==
{{AstroCategoryDoc}}

Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page.
<pre><nowiki>{{System
|image=
|name=
|region=
|sector=
|coordinates=
|xyz=
|quadrants=
|suns=
|orbits=
|stations=
|asteroids=
|comets=
|nebulae=
|routes=
|other=
|species=
|otherspecies=
|socialgroup=
|language=
|population=
|imports=
|exports=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
